name: ZCA_ORCH_BATCH_JOB_ITEMS
description: Contains the list of individual items each child job will process.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: Job Definition Id. All rows created for an ESS Job instance will have the same JobId.

columns.name: REC_NUM
columns.description: Running Sequence of number to uniquely identify a row along with other fields.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ESS job.

columns.name: CONSUMING_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Code of the consuming object. For example: LEAD, OPPORTUNITY, etc.

columns.name: CONSUMING_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the consuming object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Orchestration object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ASSOC_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Orchestration association object.

columns.name: ORCH_STEP_TRANS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Orchestration step transition id.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: Owner party identifier from the consuming object row.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Account party identifier from the consuming object row.

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_ATTR_VALUE
columns.description: Lifecycle attribute value from the consuming object row.

columns.name: JOB_ITEM_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the job item. Some possible values are: NOTSTARTED, INPROGRESS, ERRORED, and COMPLETED.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Contains the error stack trace and error message, when an object (job item) fails.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
